authors_code.source: authors' create-table10-11.do regression re-run in Stata MP 16 with reghdfe 5.7.3 (work copy authors_t10a_t11a.do); fixest reproduces b to 1e-14, SE to 4 decimals and N exactly

replication_status: exact (vs authors' code re-run; published table not available to compare)
notes: STATIC re-estimation of Table 10(a) column (5) (Sponsored): single post indicator post_st = 1{interval_st >= 0} = two_weeks_since + after_two_weeks, replacing the two published bins. published_coef is null; the closest comparators are authors_code.bin_0_2_coef / bin_3plus_coef. Authors' regression (line 38): reghdfe sponsored_dummy two_weeks_since after_two_weeks, absorb(id time_week) cluster(id); no controls, no weights. Table 10(a): two post bins relative to the product's FIRST Facebook recruitment post, [0,2] weeks (two_weeks_since) and [3,4] weeks (after_two_weeks); reference = focal weeks interval_st in [-8,-1] plus all weeks of the 2,714 never-recruited comparison products. Sample (do-file line 10): focal weeks interval_st in [-8,4] (1,490 focal products, calendar weeks 495-549) plus all 108 weeks (469-576) of comparison products; 257,346 rows before outcome NAs. Onset g = first time_week with post_st = 1: 38 cohorts, weeks 502-545 (35 focal products have no interval_st = 0 row, so g is their first observed post week). Data quirk: time_week is the year-week of each 7-day interval, so within a product the calendar offset time_week - interval varies by one week for about a quarter of focal rows, and 14% of rows share a product-week with another row (focal and comparison products alike). reghdfe/fixest accept this. gvar = onset calendar week computed on all rows of the window (so it does not move with outcome missingness); sample_filter tie_drop == 0 drops 88 rows with interval just before onset that fall in the onset calendar week (the switch-off rule run_spec applies to treat_var specs), moving the single-post TWFE from 0.05032 (authors' rows) to 0.05182 (run_spec rows); on the remaining rows 1{time_week >= g} equals the authors' post indicator exactly. Because of the duplicate product-weeks, the CSA step, when it is under the size guard, goes through did::att_gt with panel = FALSE (repeated cross-section), not the composition-fixed cells. Published table values are not available in the project (no article text or PDF); authors_code fields are the authors' code re-run on the package data. Main-text status unverified: Table 13 is Appendix D and Tables 12, 14, 15 are robustness checks, so Tables 10-11 may be appendix tables. in_abstract_intro unverified (stored abstract is one sentence).
